invbhm.reason: All four seeds paint a whole bare human skull with its lower jaw and teeth: no helmet at all (no rim, no lining, no rib cheek guards, only a thin strap), so at 1x it reads as a skull trophy, the same kind of thing as the necromancer heads invne1-invne5 beside it, and not as a helm.

fix.desc: A bone helm shown empty on its own, no head inside: the top half of a huge humanlike skull sawn off level just below the cheekbones and worn as a helmet, no lower jaw and no teeth, its two dark eye sockets as eyeholes over the brow, the hollow underside open and lined with dark stitched leather that shows along the cut edge, a riveted iron band around that cut edge, and hanging from the band at each side a long cheek guard of curved rib bones bound with dark leather thongs, a ridge of small vertebrae running back over the crown, no horns. Front three-quarter view from slightly below, so the open lined underside shows.
fix.guideSpec: new: a generic shape of our own in box/guides.py, on the 1024x1024 canvas: a skull-cap dome over the upper two thirds, two dark eye-socket holes low on its front, a level cut edge under them, and from that edge two long narrow curved cheek strips hanging down at the sides with empty space between them
fix.note: keep the skull, it is what makes a bone helm: the fix is the jaw gone and the helmet parts added; bone, so no material line
fix.seeds: a new run with style.mjs SEEDS (101-404): the changed words make new jobs

invci1.reason: All four seeds look nearly straight down into a thick tube-like ring with its points radiating outward round the upper half, so at 1x it is a spiked ring or a cog, not head jewellery; a player won't take it for a circlet-family band.

fix.desc: A coronet: a thin flat band of darkened bronze with a beaded edge, closed into a ring and seen from the front, just above eye level, so it forms a wide shallow ellipse about three times wider than it is tall, the front of the band facing the viewer and the back of the band visible through the opening; along its upper edge a row of small evenly spaced triangular points standing straight up like a tiny crown, a small dull garnet at the foot of each point, no large central gem.
fix.guideSpec: new: a generic shape of our own in box/guides.py, on the 1024x1024 canvas: a wide flat elliptical band (about 3:1, the band about a tenth of the ellipse's height), a row of small upright triangles along the top edge of its front half, the opening a lighter grey
fix.note: points all round still sets it apart from the circlet's single crest (invci0 s303), the tiara's arch and the diadem's gem plate.
fix.seeds: a new run with style.mjs SEEDS (101-404): the changed words make new jobs

invci2.reason: s101 and s202 lay the open half hoop flat with its ends up, so at 1x it reads as a necklace or torc (the amulets look like that); s303 and s404 break it into two separate crescents (cut flag P2). The filigree arch the description asks for never rises.

fix.desc: A tiara standing upright as if worn, seen from the front at eye level: a thin open-backed band of pale tarnished gold whose two ends curve back and away out of sight, and rising from its front a tall arch of fine interlaced filigree wirework, highest in the middle where it comes to a rounded point and tapering down into the thin band at the sides, a curved row of small pearls along the arch's edge and one small teardrop pearl at its peak. The arch is the tallest and widest part.
fix.guideSpec: new: a generic shape of our own in box/guides.py, on the 1024x1024 canvas: front view, a low wide arc for the band across the lower third, and above its middle a tall pointed-arch plate as wide as two thirds of the band, pierced with small lighter holes for the filigree
fix.note: one piece: if a seed still splits it (P2), take another seed rather than accept it
fix.seeds: a new run with style.mjs SEEDS (101-404): the changed words make new jobs

invdr5.reason: The description asked for a bear spirit and all four seeds painted a round-eared bear (s101/s303 read as a lion or a teddy at 1x), but the item's name is 狼灵面具, a wolf-spirit mask (src/data/d2x/armor.ts dr5), and the original is a wolf: the picture contradicts our own name and a player won't recognise the item.

fix.desc: A druid's spirit mask: a carved wooden mask of a wolf spirit's face with a long narrow muzzle, a black-painted nose, tall pointed ears carved as part of the mask and slanted eye holes, the whole face painted with bold white and ochre clay bands, framed by a thick ruff of dark shaggy fur, strings of small bones, beads and feathers hanging from its lower edge, shown empty, no head inside. Front view.
fix.note: a carved, painted wooden mask in a fur ruff, apart from the real wolf pelt of invdr1 (s101); no blue paint, no red eyes, no ear ring.
fix.seeds: a new run with style.mjs SEEDS (101-404): the changed words make new jobs

invmsk.reason: All four seeds paint a whole bald goblin head (full cranium and ears, no edge, no straps), so it reads as a severed head, not a mask, and at 1x it sits too close to the gargoyle and demon trophy heads (invne4 s202, invne5 s404); s303 also has glowing green eyes, out of the palette.

fix.desc: A war mask shown on its own, no head inside: a full face mask of beaten dark iron covering only the face from the brow to the chin, nothing behind it, its thin rolled edge showing all round and the hollow inside visible past its side, shaped as a snarling grotesque face with a heavy furrowed brow over hollow eye holes, a broad flattened nose and an open mouth baring a row of iron fangs, riveted leather straps with small buckles trailing from both sides; no scalp, no ears, no horns, no helmet. Front three-quarter view.
fix.note: the edge, the hollow and the straps are what make it a mask; at 0.85 fill the straps fit in the cells.

invpa5.reason: The crown emblem came out as a six- or eight-pointed star in all four seeds and the scalloped rim never appeared; at 1x a round dark shield with a gilt radiating emblem is nearly the targe beside it (invpa1 s101, a gilt sunburst on a round shield), and nothing says crown.

fix.desc: A paladin's crown shield: a round shield of dark steel whose gilded rim rises along its top into five tall crown points, each tipped with a small ball, like a crown set on the shield, the rest of the rim a plain gilded band with rivets; its face plain dark steel with a small round gilded boss in the middle, no star, no rays and no other emblem. Front view.
fix.guideSpec: new: a generic shape of our own in box/guides.py, on the 1024x1024 canvas: a disc, and along the top third of its edge five upright tapering points (the middle one tallest) each with a small round knob, all part of one shape
fix.note: the crown in the silhouette reads at 34 px and is unlike every other round shield (invbuc, invsml, invpa1, invpa2).
fix.seeds: a new run with style.mjs SEEDS (101-404): the changed words make new jobs

invtow.reason: Plain vertical planks and iron straps with no boss and no visible curve: at 1x all four seeds read as a wooden door, a cupboard or a crate (s404 a barrel); nothing marks it as a shield.

fix.desc: A tower shield: a tall rectangular shield with slightly rounded top corners, its face curved like a section of a large barrel so its left and right edges sweep back, seen a little from the left so the curve and the shield's thickness show; heavy vertical oak planks bound by an iron rim and two horizontal iron straps, and in the centre a large domed iron boss on a round riveted iron plate, scuffed and arrow-scarred, no painted emblem. Upright.
fix.note: the boss and the curved face are the shield cues; keep it plain oak and iron (no diamond plate, no emblem). If a seed still looks like a door, a 'tower' guide (a tall rounded-corner rectangle with a disc in the middle) would pin the boss.
